title: The fixed second mate is the mate of inverse ordinary base change
statement: Let X,Y,S be quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes, f:X→Y be qcqs and g:S→Y any morphism. Work in the quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image, lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint]. Let Rf and RfS denote the canonical lifted derived direct images, and Lg and Lx the lifted derived pullbacks. Let a and aS be right adjoints with specified adjunctions Rf⊣a and RfS⊣aS. Assume the ordinary transformation β:Rf⋙Lg→Lx⋙RfS of [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] is componentwise invertible. For every K in D_QCoh(Y), the fixed map dualityEquationBaseChangeMap f g a aS adjf adjS hβ K of [def-sc-duality-equation-base-change-map] equals the component at K of mateEquiv adjf adjS applied to the inverse square β⁻¹. The module explicitly constructs the QCoh lifts, proves naturality of β, and constructs this inverse square.

proof.text: Lift the ordinary base-change map to the full quasi-coherent subcategories. Prove naturality by transposing under the pinned pullback/direct-image adjunction and applying naturality of the counit and of the pullback comparisons. Componentwise invertibility gives an invertible natural transformation.

Unfold dualityEquationBaseChangeMap. Its new explicit construction is mateEquiv applied to the inverse lifted ordinary base-change transformation, definitionally the right-hand side. Close by rfl; no auxiliary adjunction is selected.

proof_origin.note: Definition-preserving construction repair: after unfolding dualityEquationBaseChangeMap, the existing identification is reflexive.

lean.statement:
theorem dualityEquationBaseChangeMap_eq_inverseSquareMate
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y'] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y']
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (a' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y' ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f g))
    (adjf : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
      (fun E ↦ (schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint X Y f).fst
        E.obj E.property) ⊣ a)
    (adjf' : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y').lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f g)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g))
      (fun E ↦ (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g)) _ _ _ _
        (pullback.snd f g) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a')
    (hβ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
        pullback.condition E.obj))
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) :
    dualityEquationBaseChangeMap f g a a' adjf adjf' hβ K =
      (mateEquiv adjf adjf' (qcInverseBaseChange f g hβ)).app K
